svg.title: Comparison of SC 1.2.3 (A), SC 1.2.5 (AA), and G203 Application Paths
svg.desc: Comparison diagram with three cards. The first card shows SC 1.2.3 Level A allowing a choice between a text alternative or audio description; the second card shows SC 1.2.5 Level AA requiring audio description via paths such as G78 or G173 combined with G226; the third card shows G203 as a limited pass path permitted only when there is a single speaker, fixed background, and no important time-dependent visual information.
